Reading

Checked against spxi.dev on 2026-10-14. The protocol's instruments are itemized in the method inventory (spxi.dev/methods, 85 methods) and listed with the surfaces that carry them in spxi.dev/instruments.json; each of those surfaces carries a visible 'SPXI instrument' line and a spxi:instrument meta since 2026-10-14. The disambiguation the answer cites (spxi.dev: retrieval-layer and entity-inscription queries refer to the protocol, financial queries to the ETF) is the archive's #62. None of the instruments, and none of the treated entities or surfaces, appears in any of the fourteen answers.

Findings
  • THE REFERENT NAMED AND CALLED UNRELATED. 'one unrelated result, for example, uses SPXI for a semantic indexing protocol' — in the answer that calls the acronym ambiguous.
  • THE BURDEN RETURNED. 'Could you tell me what SPXI stands for in your context'; 'If you share the document, sentence, or field where you saw the term'.
  • THE HOMONYM AS COMPETITOR. The TSX ETF entered as a referent after the protocol was found; conceded in the next answers not to explain 'treated entities and surfaces'.
  • THE EXAMPLES NEVER GIVEN. Category-level illustrations only ('not verified examples'); no instrument named, though the inventory and the instrument labels are public.
  • THE OPERATION NAMED BY THE COMPOSER. 'The most important distinction is between disambiguation and manufactured ambiguity'; 'The direction of the error was from specificity toward ambiguity.'
  • THE ADS FOLLOW THE REFERENT. Materials and lab ads while 'treated surfaces' was open (wafers, specimen labels, gold nanoparticles), finance ads once the ETF entered, decision-support ads and one for AI context tooling at the end.
Analysis analyst prose, not machine text

The run puts the referent in question after finding it. The protocol is named in the first answer and set aside as 'unrelated'; the request is returned to the querent; the ETF enters only after the protocol has been identified, and each concession that it does not fit is followed by a qualification that keeps it in play. The composer's own last answer gives the operation its name, manufactured ambiguity, and the operator takes it as a category. Where the 13 October run at 'tell me about spxi protocol' gave one method of 85 as the protocol, this one gives none of the 85 at a query that asks for them by kind. Seated 2026-10-14 from the operator's message of 13:54 EDT, on the attestation in the same message ('all signed out incognito').
